clips.title: The story
paras: Bethor Iceshard is a powerful Forsaken mage based in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. Presiding over the arcane and shadow practitioners within the Temple of the Damned, he commands considerable authority in Sylvanas's realm. Beneath his chilly demeanor lies a past entwined with old friends torn apart by the Scourge.

Standing within the Temple of the Damned, Bethor Iceshard oversees the practitioners of the arcane arts and shadow magic in the Undercity. Respected and feared for his intellect and icy resolve, Bethor wields sufficient political and magical weight to give direct instructions to provincial magistrates across Lordaeron. He directs agents of the Forsaken to secure valuable grimoires, investigate arcane anomalies, and stamp out rival powers that threaten the Undercity's dominion.

Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, Bethor was a mortal apprentice studying magic alongside two close companions: Gunther Arcanus and Thule Ravenclaw. As a testament to their fellowship, the three students wove their practice wands together. The Scourge shattered that bond entirely. When death and dark magic swept across the kingdom, Thule Ravenclaw willfully surrendered his soul to the Lich King, Gunther perished and rose on an isolated island in Brightwater Lake, and Bethor succumbed only to later break free as Forsaken.
